name: Country Sourdough Loaf
subtitle: Open-crumb wheat loaf with a little whole wheat, retarded overnight

steps.title: Build the levain
steps.desc: Stir starter, flour and lukewarm water into a smooth paste in a clean jar, mark the level and cover loosely.

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.note: half bread flour, half whole wheat

steps.title: Let the levain ripen
steps.desc: Leave at room temperature until doubled, domed and bubbly; a spoonful should float in water.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.desc: Dissolve the levain in the water, add the flours and mix until no dry flour remains, rest 20 minutes, then squeeze in the salt.

steps.title: Bulk fermentation
steps.desc: Cover and leave at room temperature until risen by about half; do four sets of stretch and folds, 30 minutes apart, during the first two hours.

steps.title: Pre-shape
steps.desc: Turn the dough out onto an unfloured counter and round it loosely with a bench scraper.

steps.title: Bench rest
steps.desc: Leave uncovered until the dough has relaxed and spread a little.

steps.title: Final shape
steps.desc: Shape a tight boule or batard and place it seam side up in a floured banneton.

steps.title: Bake
steps.desc: Preheat the oven with a Dutch oven inside to 250 °C, turn the cold dough out, score and bake 20 minutes covered, then 25 minutes uncovered at 230 °C until deep brown.
